review_reference: Backend release backend-40089515889-1-6e0593071817bac9 (D-Eminence/hid-system#111 at ba0d8d6, deployed 2026-10-24 12:09 UTC with status success for all 12 services, migration 0085_emergency_purpose_of_use applied first), which every pinned service runs. notification-api stays pinned for the emergency-contact code and alert texts (#109). Browser-facing change since 0d32961: staff break-glass (POST /api/v1/identity/break-glass) is usable in production (0085 seeds the active emergency purpose of use), and Identity now checks the break_glass_enabled platform control in the activation, answering 423 BREAK_GLASS_DISABLED when it is off or the emergency purpose is missing, and 503 PLATFORM_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE when the control cannot be read. This frontend maps 423 on the staff emergency-access form and, on novu-v1, tells staff that verified emergency contacts are told. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence.
